identity.title: Make LAS/LAZ loading responsive and cancellable

origin.kind: owner continuation request and 2026-08-22 project analysis
origin.summary: The owner deferred R0 and authorized the remaining analyzed development work. The initial audit found synchronous full-point LAS/LAZ decoding, no cancellation or progress, and repeated rescans after display-density changes.

state.current_summary: PL-0034 remains resolved; final documentation paths exist and diff hygiene passes.

objective.summary: Keep the Viewer responsive during LAS/LAZ decode and density changes while preserving deterministic bounded samples and existing inspection behavior.
constraints: Retain the existing synchronous Data API for Runner and compatibility callers.
Do not expose new formats or create the general Import surface in this slice.
Do not mutate recipe, Preview, Publish, Run, or result state merely because load progress, cancellation, or display density changes.
Do not replace the current point cloud until a requested decode completes successfully.
Use the existing Viewer status and semantic theme instead of adding a UI framework or unrelated layout.

criteria.text: The Data loader accepts cancellation and reports monotonic bounded progress while preserving existing synchronous results for the same source and sample limit.
Interactive Viewer LAS/LAZ recipe and density loading runs decode outside the UI thread, exposes visible progress, and prevents overlapping requests from applying stale results.
Cancellation or decode failure retains the prior point cloud and does not execute or mutate recipe, Preview, Publish, Run, or result state.
A previously completed source-and-budget sample is reused for later equivalent density requests without another full-file decode.
Focused loader/Viewer checks, proportional Release build, relevant LAS/LAZ runtime smoke, structure guard, and diff hygiene pass with D-backed evidence.

context.summary: Large-C3D work remains blocked on a representative maximum source and accepted memory/load-time limits.
Product-owner Wide/Compact R0 is explicitly deferred for this work sequence.

Current Release Wide 1920x1040, Compact 1280x760, and Compact in-flight Korean progress captures passed screenshot quality and remained readable on the dynamically selected leftmost monitor at the available 125% scale; contracts retained zero Preview and published result layers.
Full Release solution build passed with zero warnings/errors; Viewer display/runtime passed 111/111, Shell smoke options 42/42, and code structure 67/67.
Final git diff --check exited 0 and all five durable PL-0034 documentation/Proofline paths exist; line-ending conversion notices are warnings rather than whitespace errors.
